ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible fluke surface consists of approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels and 65% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch covers the distal 40% of the left lobe; a smaller, concentrated white patch occupies the distal 20% of the right lobe; intermediate regions show high-frequency pixel mottling at the black-white boundary interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees; vertical depth occupies 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge; approximately 14 distinct pixel-amplitude peaks on the left lobe and 12 on the right lobe, with greatest variations located in the mid-lobe segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer edges of the fluke lobes follow a convex curve that increases in slope upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups on the distal tip of the left lobe; sparse individual white spots (3-5 pixels in diameter) scattered across the black central-basal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical linear pixel disruption is visible on the right lobe, located approximately 20 pixels to the right of the median notch vertex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear scar on the right lobe near the notch; multiple macro-indentations along the trailing edge indicating past tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right lobes.
